anonymous.gate: none; redirects to the configured IdP with state, nonce and PKCE (TM-F-SSO)
anonymous.reason: SSO start must be reachable before a session exists.

anonymous.gate: signed IdP response (OIDC code with state, nonce and PKCE)
anonymous.reason: OIDC redirect back from the IdP; yields a session, or a pending sign-in when the IdP is not MFA-asserting (AN-10).

anonymous.gate: signed IdP response (SAML ACS, signed assertion, pinned algorithm)
anonymous.reason: SAML assertion consumer service (HTTP-POST binding); same outcome as the OIDC callback.

anonymous.gate: a Kerberos AP-REQ for the console's HTTP service principal, verified by the acceptor; NTLM is refused, success yields only a pending sign-in (AN-10), never a session
anonymous.reason: Integrated Windows sign-in (ADM-143); Kerberos only (TM §7.6 rules 5-7, console-sso.md §9). Off until an administrator enables it (NEG-1).

anonymous.gate: the local account's password; success yields only a pending sign-in (AN-10), never a session
anonymous.reason: Break-glass first factor when SSO is down (ADM-142); one uniform failure shape, throttled and never locked (TM §7.6 rules 1-4).
Starts the WebAuthn second factor for a pending sign-in from AN-3, AN-8 or AN-9.

anonymous.gate: the pending-sign-in cookie plus the enrolled WebAuthn credential
anonymous.reason: The only way a WebAuthn first-factor pending sign-in becomes a session (TM §7.6 rule 1).

anonymous.gate: the pending-sign-in cookie plus the enrolled TOTP factor
anonymous.reason: The only way a TOTP pending sign-in becomes a session (TM §7.6 rule 1).

anonymous.gate: the single-use state issued by the start (random, only its hash stored, ten minutes, consumed on first use) plus PKCE; the tenant is read from the state and used only to look it up
anonymous.reason: The browser's return from the Global Administrator's sign-in at the IdP (TM-D17). The console session cookie is SameSite=Strict and is not sent on this cross-site redirect.
